select
from so_b2c sb2c inner join so_b2c_logistics sb2cl on sb2c.id = sb2cl.main_id and sb2cl.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_receiver sb2cr on sb2c.id = sb2cr.main_id and sb2cr.is_deleted = false inner join shop_info si on sb2c.shop_id = si.id and si.is_deleted = false left join so_b2c_delivery sbd on sbd.source_id = sb2c.id and sb2c.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and sb2c.is_deleted = false and EXISTS (SELECT 1 from so_b2c_detail sbd where sbd.is_deleted = false and sbd.main_id = sb2c.id)
and sb2c.shop_id in (select id from shop_info where is_deleted = false and disabled = false )
and sb2c.shop_id in (select shop_id from shop_sys_user_auth where is_deleted = false and user_id = #{shopAuthResultDTO.userId} )
and sb2c.bill_status in( 'waitDistribution','inDistribution','waitShipped','frozen','partialShipped') and sb2c.invalid_status = false and sb2c.pay_status = 'paid'
order by sb2c.id desc

select count(distinct sb2c.id) from so_b2c sb2c inner join so_b2c_logistics sb2cl on sb2c.id = sb2cl.main_id and sb2cl.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_receiver sb2cr on sb2c.id = sb2cr.main_id and sb2cr.is_deleted = false inner join shop_info si on sb2c.shop_id = si.id and si.is_deleted = false
${params.sqlMap.default} and sb2c.is_deleted = false and EXISTS (SELECT 1 from so_b2c_detail sbd where sbd.is_deleted = false and sbd.main_id = sb2c.id)

sb2c.is_deleted = false and sb2c.invalid_status = false and sb2c.pay_status = 'paid' and sb2c.is_not_merge = false and (sb2c.approve_status = 'waitSubmit' or sb2c.approve_status = 'reject') and sb2c.label_json !~ 'AFN' and sb2cd.label_json !~ 'U_TAXED' and sb2cd.label_json !~ 'I_TAXED' and sb2cd.label_json !~ 'cainiaoInternationalWarehouse' and sb2c.dict_platform != 'Shopee' and sb2c.dict_platform != 'mercadolibre' and not exists (select id from so_b2c_ref where is_deleted = false and (target_id = sb2c.id or source_id = sb2c.id)) and exists (select main_id from so_b2c_detail where is_deleted = false and sb2c.id = main_id group by main_id having count(DISTINCT warehouse_id) = 1)
and sb2c.code iLIKE concat('%',#{params.code}::text,'%')
and sb2cr.name iLIKE concat('%',#{params.buyerName}::text,'%')
and sb2cr.receiver_name iLIKE concat('%',#{params.receiverName}::text,'%')
and (sb2cr.first_address iLIKE concat('%',#{params.address}::text,'%') or sb2cr.second_address ilike concat('%',#{params.address}::text,'%') or sb2cr.full_address iLIKE concat('%',#{params.address}::text,'%'))
and sb2c.dict_platform in

SELECT sb2c.id, sb2c.code, sb2c.platform_code, sb2c.shop_id, sb2cl.logistics_channel_id AS logisticsChannelId, sb2cl.track_no AS logisticsTrackNo, sb2cl.code AS logisticsTransportNo FROM so_b2c sb2c INNER JOIN so_b2c_logistics sb2cl ON sb2c.id = sb2cl.main_id and sb2cl.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE sb2c.id = #{id} AND sb2c.is_deleted=FALSE

( SELECT sb.id AS soId, sb.code AS soCode, sb.bill_status AS billStatus, sb.package_status AS packageStatus, sb.transfer_status AS transferStatus, sb.shop_id AS shopId, sbl.id AS logisticsId, sbl.logistics_channel_id AS logisticsChannelId, sbl.code AS transportNo, sbl.track_no AS trackNo, sbl.weight AS weight, sbl.transfer_logistics_supplier_id, sbl.transfer_logistics_channel_id FROM so_b2c sb INNER JOIN so_b2c_logistics sbl ON sb.id = sbl.main_id AND sbl.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sb.is_deleted = FALSE AND sb.code = #{code} LIMIT 1 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT sb.id AS soId, sb.code AS soCode, sb.bill_status AS billStatus, sb.package_status AS packageStatus, sb.transfer_status AS transferStatus, sb.shop_id AS shopId, sbl.id AS logisticsId, sbl.logistics_channel_id AS logisticsChannelId, sbl.code AS transportNo, sbl.track_no AS trackNo, sbl.weight AS weight, sbl.transfer_logistics_supplier_id, sbl.transfer_logistics_channel_id FROM so_b2c sb INNER JOIN so_b2c_logistics sbl ON sb.id = sbl.main_id AND sbl.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sb.is_deleted = FALSE and #{code} = ANY(string_to_array(sbl.track_no,',')) LIMIT 1 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT sb.id AS soId, sb.code AS soCode, sb.bill_status AS billStatus, sb.package_status AS packageStatus, sb.transfer_status AS transferStatus, sb.shop_id AS shopId, sbl.id AS logisticsId, sbl.logistics_channel_id AS logisticsChannelId, sbl.code AS transportNo, sbl.track_no AS trackNo, sbl.weight AS weight, sbl.transfer_logistics_supplier_id, sbl.transfer_logistics_channel_id FROM so_b2c sb INNER JOIN so_b2c_logistics sbl ON sb.id = sbl.main_id AND sbl.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sb.is_deleted = FALSE AND sbl.code = #{code} LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1
